{
  "project_id": "P-UK-FreeBreakfastClubs",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Delay in HM Treasury approval and budget confirmation could postpone funding availability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage Treasury early, submit detailed business case, and establish a contingency funding plan.",
      "evidence": "Management case: success depends on timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Lower than expected pupil uptake reduces attainment benefits, weakening the benefit‑cost ratio.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement targeted outreach to parents, monitor attendance data weekly, and adjust communication strategies to boost participation.",
      "evidence": "Economic case: BCR relies on attainment benefits; low uptake would reduce benefits."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Complexity of the mainstream funding model may confuse schools, leading to disengagement.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide clear guidance notes, webinars, and a help‑desk to explain the simplified funding rates.",
      "evidence": "Funding model variation by disadvantage levels was deemed complicated for mainstream schools, resulting in confusion."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Insufficient physical space in some schools could limit the ability to run breakfast clubs.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy technical estate advisers to assess space and recommend reconfiguration or shared‑use arrangements.",
      "evidence": "Technical estate advisers to test what schools can do to mitigate any space constraints."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Schools may struggle to recruit or retain staff needed for supervised childcare.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Offer recruitment incentives, provide training packages, and allow flexible staffing models within funding rules.",
      "evidence": "Costing approach assumes typical staffing patterns; risk if schools cannot staff as assumed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Delays in procuring additional advisers through the education and children’s social care framework.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Accelerate procurement timelines, set firm contract award dates, and maintain a shortlist of pre‑qualified suppliers.",
      "evidence": "Procurement process to increase number of advisers supporting schools through the education and children's social care framework."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "The internal CRM system may not be ready by the November 2025 MVP deadline, hindering school onboarding.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Allocate dedicated development resources, adopt agile milestones, and have a fallback manual onboarding process.",
      "evidence": "Develop a customer relationship management system internally, working towards a minimum-viable product from November 2025."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Call‑centre pilot for data collection could fail, limiting programme monitoring.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Run a small‑scale pilot, define clear service level agreements, and retain alternative data‑submission channels.",
      "evidence": "Start commercial processes to begin a call-centre pilot to support data collection."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "A gap in provision may occur if NSBP schools do not transition to FBC after July 2026.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Create a transition checklist, monitor NSBP school sign‑ups, and provide interim support where gaps appear.",
      "evidence": "All NSBP schools guaranteed a place to ensure they do not have a gap in provision after NSBP closure July 2026."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Delay in the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Bill could postpone the mandatory duty for schools.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain liaison with legislative teams, prepare interim guidance, and align funding timelines with expected enactment dates.",
      "evidence": "Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill will place a duty on schools; legislation required for programme."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Changes in government priorities or budget cuts could reduce allocated funding.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Demonstrate early wins, produce regular value‑for‑money reports, and build cross‑departmental support to safeguard funding.",
      "evidence": "Programme success depends on timely approval and budget confirmation; changes in government priorities could affect funding."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Disruptions in food supply chains may prevent schools from meeting food standards.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish multiple approved suppliers, maintain buffer stock, and set contingency menus compliant with standards.",
      "evidence": "Food provided must be in line with school food standards."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Insufficient parental awareness could limit attendance and undermine programme objectives.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Launch a coordinated communications campaign through schools, local authorities, and community groups.",
      "evidence": "Evaluation will measure pupil participation and identify factors influencing attendance, including parental demand."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Area cost adjustments may be higher than projected, leading to budget overruns.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply a sensitivity buffer in the budget and review adjustments quarterly against actual labour market data.",
      "evidence": "Area cost adjustment applied using national funding formula; variations could affect affordability."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Onboarding of the first cohort of ~500 schools may be delayed, pushing back the April 2026 start.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a pre‑onboarding checklist, provide early technical support, and monitor progress against a detailed timeline.",
      "evidence": "Cohort 1 will begin delivery in April 2026; onboarding of ~500 schools required."
    }
  ]
}
